material_claims.proposition: Mental Capacity Act 2005 sections 5 to 29 came into force on 1 October 2007.
material_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: the following provisions of the act come into force on 1 october 2007- a sections 5 to 29; b sections 45 to 63; c sections 65 to 69; and d schedules 1 to 7.

currentness_claims.proposition: Mental Capacity Act 2005 sections 1 to 4 came into force for all purposes on 1 October 2007.
currentness_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: the following provisions of the act, which have already been commenced for limited purposes, come into force on 1 october 2007 for all purposes- a section 1 (principles); b section 2 (people who lack capacity); c section 3 (inability to make decisions); d section 4 (best interests); e sections 42(4) and (5) (codes of practice); and f section 64 (interpretation).

bindings.proposed_action: Approve this immutable as-made commencement order as currentness evidence for the Mental Capacity Act proposition bindings.

material_claims.proposition: The section 80 and Schedule 6 amendments do not apply to a decision taken before 5 February 2026 that fell within the specified former automated-decision provisions.
material_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: the amendments made by section 80 of, and schedule 6 to, the 2025 act do not apply in relation to any decision taken before 5th february 2026 to which article 22(3) of the uk gdpr (automated individual decision-making, including profiling) or section 14 or 50(2) of the 2018 act (automated decision-making authorised by law: safeguards) applied.
